focus: D1 Correctness - switch semantics and the guard surface

findingDetails.title: Shell truthy check deletes internal whitespace, diverging from the Node and Python readers
findingDetails.evidence: tr -d '[:space:]' deletes internal whitespace before the truthy case; hook-flags.cjs:93-97 and validation_switch.py:43-45 trim only the edges, so a quoted value like "o n" reads on in the shell reader and off in Node/Python. The cross-reader table does not pin an internal-whitespace row.
findingDetails.recommendation: Trim edges only in the shell mirror (sed) or pin the divergence in the cross-reader test table as a documented difference.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read all three resolver implementations and the cross-reader test; no table row covers internal whitespace.
